Return a [[Holy Relic]] stolen by [[Grawl]] raiders to [[Sardelac Sanitarium]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = necromancer
}}

===Objectives===
* Find the Grawl that have stolen the relic. Look for them in the fields just north of the Sanitarium.
* Escort [[Necromancer Munne]] and the relic back to the sanitarium. {{sic|"sanitarium" is lowercase here}}
* Return to Necromancer Munne for your reward.

===Reward===
* 200 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{skill icon|Animate Bone Horror}}
* {{skill icon|Deathly Swarm}}
* {{skill icon|Insidious Parasite}}
* {{skill icon|Life Siphon}}

==Walkthrough==
Meet Necromancer Munne outside the Sardelac Sanitarium and follow her north into the fields. Kill the three Grawl and pick up the Holy Relic they drop. Haul the artifact back to the Sanitarium's entrance and present it to Munne. You must be holding the quest item when you speak to her to get your reward.

==Interactive objects==
* [[Holy Relic]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Necromancer Munne
:''"So you wish to prove yourself a true [[Necromancer]]? Then I have a task for you. A group of '''Grawl''' raided the Sanitarium several days past. We drove them off but not before they carried off a valuable artifact, a '''holy relic''' that [[Mhenlo]] had retrieved from [[The Catacombs|the catacombs]]. The Grawl were last seen just north of here. I shall accompany you on this mission to evaluate your performance. When you are ready, meet me just outside of the Sanitarium.''

:''"What say you?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will undertake this challenge.
| decline = Sounds dangerous. I think I'll pass.
| ask = Meet me outside of the Sanitarium. We will then go and deal with those '''Grawl'''.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
Upon entering [[Old Ascalon]]:
:'''Necromancer Munne:''' ''"Now then, let us go retrieve our lost relic. Follow me."''
Upon defeating all three Grawl:
:'''Necromancer Munne:''' ''"Why don't you carry that relic back to the Sanitarium. {{sic|A question mark should be used here.}} I don't like to do the heavy lifting."''
Upon picking up the artifact:
:'''Necromancer Munne:''' ''"Follow me {{sic|missing comma}} young Necromancer."''
Once Munne reaches the Sanitarium entrance:
:'''Necromancer Munne:''' ''"This should be far enough. Bring the relic to me. I'll make sure that it gets back to its proper place in the Sanitarium."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Necromancer Munne
:''"With the return of this relic, the inmates of the Sanitarium will sleep easier this night. And it's all thanks to you. You show some real talent for the high art of Necromancy."''

==Notes==
* The three Grawl that spawn as part of this quest will attack other Grawl that enter their [[aggro]] range.
